text:
Matt Boldy has 83 shots on goal in 20 games, the most on the Wild, and only seven goals to show for it. On 10.7 expected goals, that's one of the larger gaps in the league, and goals tend to follow chances.

Everything else is going well. Minnesota takes 60% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, ten points better than without him, and the Wild have points in nine straight. The headlines this fall are about Boldy giving Kirill Kaprizov another threat to lean on, which is what a 42-goal scorer from last season should be.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him breaking out with possession 70% of the time and carrying the puck in on 57% of his entries, and Evolving-Hockey had him 32nd of 401 forwards in wins above replacement. We have him at 41% to score tonight in Toronto, the second-highest on either side. Our range: 30 to 47 goals.
